headline: Nvidia's AI Chip Sales in China Stall as Local Makers Like Huawei Take Lead, Confirming US Export Control Circumvention.
summary: This signals a major geopolitical shift in the global AI chip market, demonstrating the immediate impact of US export controls on American tech giants while highlighting China's rapid indigenous development and self-sufficiency, particularly through advanced packaging techniques like 3D stacking. This escalation in the US-China tech war will accelerate the re-shaping of global AI infrastructure, semiconductor supply chains, and foster increasingly fragmented technological ecosystems.
